debrief db-021
1) the actor c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d the s-e-c-r-e-t p-l-a-n with two other firms and left r-e-c-o-r-d-s of the a-g-r-e-e-m-e-n-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e r-e-v-i-e-w
2) the actor s-t-r-u-c-t-u-r-e-d the t-e-n-d-e-r to include fake cover bids and left a d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t showing the c-o-n-s-p-i-r-a-c-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the v-a-l-i-d-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k
3) the actor a-r-r-a-n-g-e-d for hidden compensation between the parties and left p-a-y-m-e-n-t d-e-t-a-i-l-s in the f-i-l-e-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-m-e-n-t
4) the actor e-x-c-h-a-n-g-e-d pricing information with competitors and left m-e-e-t-i-n-g n-o-t-e-s of the s-h-a-r-i-n-g while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-n-t-i-t-r-u-s-t l-a-w r-e-v-i-e-w
5) the actor s-e-t up a rotation schedule for who would win and left a c-a-l-e-n-d-a-r showing the r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-a-i-r-n-e-s-s a-u-d-i-t
